#   FireHOL IP Blocklist › Web Server
#   
#   A web server IP blacklist made from blocklists that track IPs that should
#   never be used by your web users. (This list includes IPs that are servers
#   hosting malware, bots, etc or users having a long criminal history.
#   
#   This list is to be used on top of firehol_level1, firehol_level2,
#   firehol_level3 and possibly firehol_proxies or firehol_anonymous).
#   
#   This list is integrated with other firehol lists:
#       - myip
#       - stopforumspam_toxic
#   
#   This third-party blocklist is not maintained by ConfigServer; IPs are
#   sourced externally and not curated by us. We do however, validate the
#   blocklist to ensure that it only contains properly validated IP addresses,
#   and does not include any non-relevant or malformed data beyond the scope
#   of the source.
#   
#   Use at the administrator’s discretion based on risk tolerance and
#   environment requirements.
